lede: Mobil Sunguan Auto Centre is a car workshop in MacPherson Road. Its own website lists oil change, repair service, car restoration and two-wheeler repair.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention car maintenance, second opinions on repairs and parking space. One customer noted that payment is cash only.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, workshop.sea.mobil.com.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
